_comment: Infinite Rails dedicated server. Needs the image from Dockerfiles/pterodactyl-infiniterails (ghcr.io/solipsist01/pterodactyl-infiniterails). Import via admin panel -> Nests -> Import Egg.
name: Infinite Rails
author: admin@example.com
description: Infinite Rails dedicated server (Steam tool app 5484540, anonymous SteamCMD download, Linux build). Updates itself on every start (Auto Update). Port comes from the primary allocation (UDP). World, whitelist, permissions and all other settings are in InfiniteRails_Data/config.txt - edit it in the File Manager, see InfiniteRails_Data/README.txt.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Pterodactyl install script for Infinite Rails (runs in the install container as root,
## server files mounted at /mnt/server). Safe to re-run (Reinstall keeps world + config:
## SteamCMD only replaces the game files, InfiniteRails_Data/config.txt, Worlds/ etc. stay).
set -e
cd /mnt/server

echo "== SteamCMD =="
mkdir -p steamcmd
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi

export HOME=/mnt/server
BRANCH_ARGS=""
[ -n "${STEAM_BRANCH}" ] && [ "${STEAM_BRANCH}" != "public" ] && BRANCH_ARGS="-beta ${STEAM_BRANCH}"

echo "== Infinite Rails Dedicated Server (app 5484540) =="
# app_info_update first: without it a fresh SteamCMD answers "Missing configuration"
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
    +login anonymous +app_info_update 1 +app_update 5484540 ${BRANCH_ARGS} validate +quit

# Steam client libs where Steamworks looks for them
mkdir -p .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/ 2>/dev/null || true

[ -x InfiniteRails.x86_64 ] || { echo "!! InfiniteRails.x86_64 missing after install"; ls -la; exit 1; }
chmod +x InfiniteRails.x86_64
echo "== Install done =="

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = update the server with SteamCMD on every start, 0 = never (update with Reinstall).

variables.name: Steam Branch
variables.description: Leave empty for the current version. Or an older branch such as v0.7.7 if the server must match players on an older game version.

variables.name: Login Required
variables.description: 1 = players must /register and /login with a password (recommended for a public server: without it anybody can use anybody's name). 0 = off. Empty = leave config.txt as is.

variables.name: Creative Mode
variables.description: 1 = creative (free building, no money), 0 = normal. Empty = leave config.txt as is.

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: Sent to every player who joins. Empty = leave config.txt as is.
